description: This file contains FastAPI application code with endpoint definitions that utilize dependency injection using Depends. It also includes test functions that test the application's API responses.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with a single 'data' field.

methods.name: duplicate_dependency(item: Item)
methods.description: A dependency function that returns the item passed to it.

methods.name: dependency(item2: Item)
methods.description: A dependency function that returns the item passed to it.

methods.name: sub_duplicate_dependency( item: Item, sub_item: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency) )
methods.description: A composite dependency that depends on 'duplicate_dependency' and returns a list containing the item and sub-item.

methods.name: with_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency))
methods.description: An endpoint that returns a list of two identical Item objects, demonstrating dependency injection.

methods.name: no_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(dependency))
methods.description: An endpoint that returns a list of two different Item objects.

methods.name: no_duplicates_sub( item: Item, sub_items: list[Item] = Depends(sub_duplicate_dependency) )
methods.description: An endpoint that returns an Item and a list of Items, using a dependent with sub-dependencies.

methods.name: test_no_duplicates_invalid()
methods.description: Test function that verifies validation failure when 'item2' is missing in the request body for '/no-duplicates'.

methods.name: test_no_duplicates()
methods.description: Test function that verifies successful POST request returning two items.

methods.name: test_duplicates()
methods.description: Test function that verifies the '/with-duplicates' endpoint returns a list with the same item twice.

methods.name: test_sub_duplicates()
methods.description: Test function that verifies the '/with-duplicates-sub' endpoint returns an item and a list of items.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Test function that verifies the OpenAPI schema JSON of the FastAPI application.

ctags.name: no_duplicates
ctags.pattern: /^async def no_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(dependency)):$/

ctags.name: with_duplicates
ctags.pattern: /^async def with_duplicates(item: Item, item2: Item = Depends(duplicate_dependency)):$/
